title: CBR1000RR-R Fireblade SP (Rally Edition)
description: The Honda CBR1000RR-R Fireblade SP (Rally Edition) is engineered for blistering apex speeds and track dominance, positioned in the Middleweight Sportbike segment for riders demanding engaging everyday dynamics. Powered by a 1000cc engine generating 154 HP and 123 Nm of torque against a curb weight of 228 kg, it delivers predictable, roll-on throttle response across its usable powerband. The cockpit is configured with an Aggressive Forward Tuck riding stance and a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, making daily city navigation as intuitive as weekend backroad escapes.
